text.description_html:
RK International CP-39, Ridged Foot Cabinet Door Pull

Perfectly retro or sleek and modern depending on how you look at it, the Deco 3 Inch Cabinet Pull has a timelessness. This enduring style--one that is able to go from traditional to contemporary without much effort--is highly prized in door hardware. In ten years when you look at your kitchen, your eyes won't catch on out-dated cabinet pulls, they will see pulls that remain current in the ever-changing world of home-decor. It is this timelessness, this effortlessness, this enduring beauty that makes the ridged foot cabinet door pull so great. It has a 3 inch center to center and is available in 6 finishes.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-39 3" Lined Flat Foot Bow Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 5-3/16"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 15/16"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
